defs.d: Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of (that).
defs.ex: He told me not to do it. I, however, did it anyway. / I did it anyway, however. / (sometimes proscribed:) However, I did it anyway.

defs.d: (degree) To whatever degree or extent
defs.ex: However clear you think you've been, many questions will remain.

defs.d: In whatever way or manner.
defs.ex: she offered to help however she could

defs.d: Although, though, but, yet.
An act or instance of swimming.
defs.ex: I'm going for a swim.

defs.d: The sound, or air bladder, of a fish.
To move through the water, without touching the bottom; to propel oneself in water by natural means.
To become immersed in, or as if in, or flooded with, or as if with, a liquid
defs.ex: a bare few bits of meat swimming in watery sauce

defs.d: The act of returning.
defs.ex: I expect the house to be spotless upon my return.

defs.d: A return ticket.
defs.ex: Do you want a one-way or a return?

defs.d: To come or go back (to a place or person).
defs.ex: Although the birds fly north for the summer, they return here in winter.

defs.d: To go back in thought, narration, or argument.
defs.ex: To return to my story [...]

defs.d: To listen to (something or someone); to pay attention to; regard; heed.
To listen (to, unto).
To give (especially public) notice of (something); to announce publicly.
To provide information about a person or goods and services to influence others.
defs.ex: For personal needs, advertise on the internet or in a local newspaper.

defs.d: Communication whose purpose is to influence potential customers about products and services.
The industry or profession made up of such communications.
A point at which reflected or refracted rays of light converge.
defs.ex: The heat of sunlight at the focus of a magnifying glass can easily set dry leaves on fire.

defs.d: A point of a conic at which rays reflected from a curve or surface converge.
(followed by on or upon) To concentrate one's attention.
defs.ex: I have to focus on my work.

defs.d: To cause (rays of light, etc) to converge at a single point.
Any plant of the family Poaceae, characterized by leaves that arise from nodes in the stem and leaf bases that wrap around the stem, especially those grown as ground cover rather than for grain.
Various plants not in family Poaceae that resemble grasses.
To lay out on the grass; to knock down (an opponent etc.).
To act as a grass or informer, to betray; to report on (criminals etc) to the authorities.
The fact of knowing about something; general understanding or familiarity with a subject, place, situation etc.
defs.ex: His knowledge of Iceland was limited to what he'd seen on the Travel Channel.

defs.d: Awareness of a particular fact or situation; a state of having been informed or made aware of something.
To confess as true; to acknowledge.
A lazy person.
Sloth (animal).
To laze, act in a lazy manner.
Unwilling to do work or make an effort; disinclined to exertion.
defs.ex: Get out of bed, you lazy lout!

defs.d: Causing or characterised by idleness; relaxed or leisurely.
defs.ex: I love staying inside and reading on a lazy Sunday.

defs.d: A physical divider intended to block an area from view, or provide shelter from something dangerous.
defs.ex: a fire screen

defs.d: A material woven from fine wires intended to block animals or large particles from passing while allowing gasses, liquids and finer particles to pass.
To filter by passing through a screen.
defs.ex: Mary screened the beans to remove the clumps of gravel.

defs.d: To shelter or conceal.
The middle layer of the wall of a blood vessel or lymph vessel which is composed of connective and muscular tissue.
A voiced stop consonant.
Happening through bad luck, or because of some unfortunate event.
Used (as a parenthetical word) to express disappointment, compassion, sorrow, regret or grief.
A series of operations undertaken to achieve a set goal.
defs.ex: The company is targeting children in their latest advertising campaign.

defs.d: The period during which a blast furnace is continuously in operation.
To take part in a campaign.
defs.ex: She campaigned for better social security.

defs.d: Consistently ride in races for a racing season.
A distinctive outfit that serves to identify members of a group.
Phonetic equivalent for the letter U in the ICAO spelling alphabet, informally known as the NATO phonetic alphabet.
To clothe in a uniform.
Unvarying; all the same.
Consistent; conforming to one standard.
To change (something) from a smaller form and/or size to a larger one; to spread out or lay open.
defs.ex: You can expand this compact umbrella to cover a large table.

defs.d: To increase the extent, number, volume or scope of (something).
defs.ex: A flower expands its leaves.

defs.d: Something or someone reliable or dependable
defs.ex: the old reliables

defs.d: Suitable or fit to be relied on; worthy of dependence, reliance or trust; dependable, trustworthy
(of a communication protocol) Such that either a sent packet will reach its destination, even if it requires retransmission, or the sender will be told that it didn't
Plainly; clearly; manifestly; evidently.
Seemingly; in appearance only.
defs.ex: A man may be apparently friendly, yet malicious in heart.

defs.d: Something given or offered that adds to a larger whole.
An amount of money given toward something.
A temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to.
A list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting).
A task which ought to be done.
A burden; a weight to be carried.
defs.ex: I struggled up the hill with the heavy load in my rucksack.

defs.d: A worry or concern to be endured, especially in the phrase a load off one's mind.
To put a load on or in (a means of conveyance or a place of storage).
defs.ex: The dock workers refused to load the ship.

defs.d: To place in or on a conveyance or a place of storage.
defs.ex: He loaded his stuff into his storage locker.

defs.d: A line marking the boundary of an object figure.
The outer shape of an object or figure.
To draw an outline of.
To summarize.
defs.ex: Wikipedia items featuring books usually outline them after giving their background.

defs.d: (manner) In accordance with the facts; truthfully, accurately.
(modal) Honestly, genuinely, in fact, really.
defs.ex: That is truly all I know.

defs.d: To choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options.
defs.ex: He looked over the menu, and selected the roast beef.

defs.d: To obtain a set of data from a database using a query.
Privileged, specially selected.
defs.ex: Only a select few were allowed into the premiere.

defs.d: Of high quality; top-notch.
defs.ex: This is a select cut of beef.
